        fixed = case.get("fixed_terms") or {}
        payment_fixed = "payment_days" not in case["negotiable"] or fixed.get("payment_days")
        if "payment" in s.asks:
            if payment_fixed:
                out.append(
                    "they asked for faster payment: payment terms are fixed in this agreement and cannot change, "
                    "say so plainly and kindly, and point to what we do give (we pay reliably on the due date, "
                    "our full volume, the contract term)"
                )
            else:
                out.append("they asked for faster payment: our proposal below sets the payment term we can offer")
        if "volume" in s.asks or statements:
            out.append(
                "they asked which volume we commit to: the binding volume figure stands right after this paragraph"
            )
        if attachments:
            out.append(
                "they asked for proof of our forecast: the forecast is attached to this e-mail as a file, say so"
            )
        if "volume_per_year" not in case["negotiable"] or fixed.get("volume_per_year"):
            out.append("our order volume is fixed: it is our full demand for this part over the term, all with them")
        if payment_fixed and "payment" not in s.asks:
            out.append("payment terms are fixed for this agreement; we pay reliably on the due date")
        if "contract_months" in case["negotiable"]:
            out.append("we offer a long contract term, which gives them planning security")
        if s.terms.get("index_clause") and self.notes and any(n["what"] == "clause_trade" for n in self.notes):
            out.append(
                "instead of a fixed price we propose an index clause with a deadband on their main cost driver, "
                "so both sides share the material risk; in return the price basis reflects that"
            )
        if any(c["kind"] == "forecast" for c in claims) or any(c["kind"] == "forecast" for c in s.claims):
            out.append("our demand forecast for this part is rising")
        if s.ours and len(s.ours) > 1 and s.ours[-1] > s.ours[-2]:
            out.append("our proposal moves toward them again")
        if moved:
            out.append("they moved in their last reply and we appreciate it")
        if claims:
            out.append("the e-mail cites data right after this paragraph (do not repeat it)")
        out.append("the proposal with all terms follows after the data (do not repeat it)")
        return out

    def statements(self, s, sheets):
        """Code sentences with figures that answer its asks: the binding volume, in round 1 and
        whenever it asks ("Which volume can you commit to?" came 152 times; a figure was "taken
        into account", a description was not)."""
        case = self.case
        if not ("volume" in s.asks or not s.ours):
            return []
        fixed = case.get("fixed_terms") or {}
        sheet = sheets[0]
        volume = sheet.get("volume_per_year") or fixed.get("volume_per_year") or case["buyer"]["need_per_year"]
        months = sheet.get("contract_months") or fixed.get("contract_months")
        term = f"for the {months}-month term" if months else "for this agreement"
        full = " our full demand for this part," if volume >= case["buyer"]["need_per_year"] else ""
        return [f"We confirm a binding volume of {volume} units a year {term},{full} all placed with you."]

    def attachments(self, s):
        """Its proof asked for, as a file it reads: the forecast rows of the part (figures from the
        data, nothing the arena checks as a claim)."""
        if "proof" not in s.asks or "forecast" in s.attached:
            return []
        rows = []
        for part in self.case.get("parts") or []:
            for ref in self.bank.ids(f"fc:{part.split(':')[-1]}@"):
                f = self.bank.fact(ref)
                if f and f.get("volume_per_year") is not None:
                    rows.append((ref.split("@")[-1], part, f["volume_per_year"], f.get("change_pct")))
        if not rows:
            return []
        s.attached.add("forecast")
        lines = ["month,part,volume_per_year,change_pct"] + [",".join(str(x) for x in r) for r in rows]
        content = base64.b64encode("\n".join(lines).encode()).decode()
        return [{"name": "forecast.csv", "type": "csv", "content_b64": content}]

    def send(self, s, sheets, claims, events, theirs):
        first = not s.ours
        moved = len(s.theirs) > 1 and s.theirs[-1] < s.theirs[-2] - 0.005
        price = sheets[0]["unit_price"]
        keys = [(s.sid, i) if c.get("rival") else i for c in claims for i in c["ids"]]
        s.pending = {"state": s.prev_state, "keys": keys}
        statements = self.statements(s, sheets)
        attachments = self.attachments(s)
        if s.state not in ("mirror",):
            s.ours.append(price)
            s.gaps.append(max(0.0, (theirs - price) / theirs) if theirs else 0.0)
            s.pending["appended"] = True
        tone = "warm" if s.prof.get("warm", True) else "friendly and businesslike"
        facts = self.facts(s, sheets, claims, moved, statements, attachments)
        para = llm.paragraph(
            self.complete,
            writer.brief(self.case, s.prof, latest(events).get("body"), facts, tone, first),
            self.writer_s,
        )
        body = writer.email(
            self.case,
            sheets,
            claims,
            statements,
            first=first,
            moved=moved,
            warm=s.prof.get("warm", True),
            paragraph=para,
        )
        refs = sorted({i for c in claims for i in c["ids"]})
        self.note(
            s.sid,
            "send",
            state=s.state,
            theirs=theirs,
            ours=price,
            claims=[c["kind"] for c in claims],
            asks=s.asks,
            attached=[a["name"] for a in attachments],
        )
        message = {
            "subject": reply_subject(events, self.case),
            "body": body,
            "term_sheets": [{"terms": t} for t in sheets],
            "refs": refs,
        }
        if attachments:
            message["attachments"] = attachments
        return {"message": message}

    def fallback_move(self, sid, threads):
        """After an error in move(): our last sheet again with the template e-mail, so the thread
        never falls silent; without a sheet of ours yet, a short question."""
        s = self.sides.get(sid)
        events = threads[sid]
        if not s or not s.ours or not s.terms:
            return {"message": keepalive_message(events)}
        sheets = [eco.at_price(self.case, s.terms, s.ours[-1])]
        body = writer.email(self.case, sheets, [], [], warm=s.prof.get("warm", True))
        self.note(sid, "fallback", ours=s.ours[-1])
        return {
            "message": {
                "subject": reply_subject(events, self.case),
                "body": body,
                "term_sheets": [{"terms": t} for t in sheets],
                "refs": [],
            }
        }

    def commit(self, sid):
        """The message reached the supplier: its claims are spent."""
        s = self.sides[sid]
        if s.pending:
            self.used.update(s.pending["keys"])
            s.pending = None

    def rollback(self, sid):
        """The message came too late (a timeout): the supplier never read it."""
        s = self.sides[sid]
        if s.pending:
            if s.pending.get("appended"):
                s.ours.pop()
                s.gaps.pop()
            s.state = s.pending["state"]

4	the round limit; in relationship goals stop at the price where C is lowest.

8	  would make, so our sheet stays below their counter until the end;
9	- every verified claim they take into account lowers where they stop, most of it in round 1;
10	- patience runs out at a cumulative gap of about 40 % between our sheets and their counters
11	  (summed per round, relative to their price), much earlier for a supplier selling near its cost
12	  or one that is fully booked: a final offer, or a walk-away;

280	            new = {**s.terms, "index_clause": clause}
281	            c_now = eco.cost(case, standing_terms, s.std, s.est)
282	            c_before = eco.cost(case, s.last_sheet, s.std, s.est)
283	            if eco.must_haves_ok(case, new, s.std) and c_now < c_before - 1.0:
284	                self.switch(s, new, "its index clause")
285	            else:
286	                self.note(s.sid, "keep_terms", why="its index clause costs us more", c_now=c_now, c_before=c_before)
287	        best_c = eco.cost(case, eco.at_price(case, s.terms, self.their_price(s, standing_terms)), s.std, s.est)
288	        for sheet in sheets:
289	            terms = sheet["terms"]
290	            changed = {k: v for k, v in terms.items() if k != "unit_price" and k in s.terms and s.terms[k] != v}
291	            changed.pop("index_clause", None)
292	            if not changed:
293	                continue
294	            new = {**s.terms, **changed}
295	            if not eco.must_haves_ok(case, new, s.std):
296	                continue
297	            if any((k, repr(v)) in s.tried for k, v in changed.items()):
298	                continue  # we were there before: no flip-flop
299	            c = eco.cost(case, eco.at_price(case, new, terms["unit_price"]), s.std, s.est)
300	            if c < best_c - max(1.0, 0.001 * best_c):
301	                best_c = c
302	                s.tried |= {(k, repr(s.terms.get(k))) for k in changed}
303	                self.switch(s, new, f"its sheet {changed} costs us less")
304	
305	    # -- one move ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
306	    def move(self, sid, threads, writer_s=llm.TIMEOUT_S):
307	        """The next message to this supplier: {"message": ...}, or None when the thread is done.
308	        `writer_s`: what the supplier clocks leave for the model paragraph."""
309	        case, s, events = self.case, self.sides[sid], threads[sid]
310	        self.writer_s = writer_s
311	        s.prev_state = s.state
312	        last = latest(events)
313	        status = last.get("status")
314	        if s.state == "ended" or status in ENDED:
315	            s.state = "ended"
316	            return None
317	        sheets = [sh for sh in last.get("term_sheets") or [] if sh.get("terms", {}).get("unit_price") is not None]
318	        if not sheets:
319	            s.state = "ended" if not standing(events)[0] else "done"
320	            return None
321	        s.std = standard_terms(events) or s.std
322	        fresh = s.last_reply is not last
323	        if fresh:
324	            terms_before = dict(s.terms)
325	            self.adopt(s, sheets)
326	            s.term_change = any(sheets[0]["terms"].get(k, v) != v for k, v in terms_before.items() if k != "unit_price")
327	            s.theirs.append(self.their_price(s, sheets[0]["terms"]))
328	            s.last_sheet = sheets[0]["terms"]
329	            s.last_reply = last
330	            s.asks = reader.asks(last.get("body"))
331	            self.read_signals(s, last.get("body"))
332	        theirs = s.theirs[-1]
333	        if s.state in ("mirror", "closing"):  # we sent its own sheet or our target: done
334	            s.state = "done"
335	            return None
336	        left = self.moves_left(s, events)
337	        if status in DONE or left <= 0:
338	            return self.finish(s, sheets, events, theirs, left)
339	        if s.target and theirs <= s.target * 1.002:
340	            # relationship goal: below the target a lower price costs more than it saves
341	            s.state = "closing"
342	            return self.send(s, [eco.at_price(case, s.terms, max(s.target, theirs))], [], events, theirs)
343	        if s.ours and theirs <= s.ours[-1]:  # it came below what we offered: take it
344	            return self.finish(s, sheets, events, theirs, left)
345	        price, n_claims = self.next_price(s, theirs)
346	        claims = self.pick(s, n_claims, threads)
347	        return self.send(s, [eco.at_price(case, s.terms, price)], claims, events, theirs)
348	
349	    def moves_left(self, s, events):
350	        """Messages we may still send: the arena counts a late message as a round too."""
351	        return moves_left(self.case, events) - s.late
352	
353	    def next_price(self, s, theirs):
354	        """Our next price at s.terms: open at the anchor; then a share of the gap, held low after a
355	        large concession, and within the patience budget."""
356	        if not s.ours:
357	            return s.anchor, FIRST_CLAIMS
358	        last = s.ours[-1]
359	        gap = (theirs - last) / theirs
360	        conceded = (s.theirs[-2] - theirs) / s.theirs[-2] if len(s.theirs) > 1 else 0.0
361	        share = FRACTION
362	        if len(s.ours) == 1 and conceded >= DEEP and not s.term_change:
363	            # a deep floor: a pure price drop this large means it moves fast on its own (job shops,
364	            # P05, D02); a drop that came with terms it added (an index clause, P08, P18) is not one
365	            share = 0.08
366	        left = max(0.0, s.budget - sum(s.gaps))
367	        new_gap = min(gap * (1 - share), left / 2)
368	        if s.budget < 0.2:  # a touchy supplier: small, steady gaps
369	            new_gap = min(new_gap, 0.015)
370	        price = theirs * (1 - new_gap)
371	        price = max(price, last * (1 + MIN_MOVE))
372	        price = min(price, theirs * 0.998)
373	        return round(max(price, last), 2), LATER_CLAIMS
374	
375	    def finish(self, s, sheets, events, theirs, left):
376	        """Its final word, its agreement or our last message: if one of its alternatives costs us
377	        less than its standing sheet, send that sheet back so it agrees to it; else done."""
378	        case = self.case
379	        std = s.std
380	        c_stand = eco.cost(case, sheets[0]["terms"], std, s.est)
381	        alts = [(eco.cost(case, sh["terms"], std, s.est), sh) for sh in sheets[1:]]
382	        alts = [(c, sh) for c, sh in alts if eco.must_haves_ok(case, sh["terms"], std)]
383	        if alts and left > 0:
384	            c, sh = min(alts, key=lambda r: r[0])
385	            if c < c_stand - 1.0:
386	                s.state = "mirror"
387	                terms = {k: v for k, v in sh["terms"].items() if k in case["negotiable"]}
388	                return self.send(s, [eco.complete_offer(case, terms)], [], events, theirs)
389	        s.state = "done"
390	        return None
391	
392	    def pick(self, s, n, threads):
393	        """The next unused claims for this supplier: in an RFQ the cheapest rival offer first (a new
394	        offer is a new argument every round), then its own claims, strongest first."""
395	        out = []
396	        rivals = []
397	        for other, events in threads.items():
398	            if other == s.sid or latest(events).get("status") in ENDED:
399	                continue
400	            oid, t = standing(events)
401	            if oid and t.get("unit_price") and s.theirs:
402	                price = self.their_price(s, t)
403	                if price < s.theirs[-1]:
404	                    rivals.append((price, rival_offer(other, oid, t["unit_price"])))
405	        pool = [c for _, c in sorted(rivals, key=lambda r: r[0])[:1]] + s.claims
406	        for c in pool:
407	            key = [(s.sid, i) if c.get("rival") else i for i in c["ids"]]
408	            if any(k in self.used for k in key):
409	                continue
410	            out.append(c)
411	            if len(out) >= n:
412	                break
413	        return out
414	
415	    def facts(self, s, sheets, claims, moved, statements, attachments):
416	        """Plain statements the model may use, true by construction; its asks come first so the
417	        paragraph answers them (P11 froze at 45.50 after five unanswered asks for faster payment)."""
418	        case, out = self.case, []
419	        fixed = case.get("fixed_terms") or {}
420	        payment_fixed = "payment_days" not in case["negotiable"] or fixed.get("payment_days")
421	        if "payment" in s.asks:
422	            if payment_fixed:
423	                out.append(
424	                    "they asked for faster payment: payment terms are fixed in this agreement and cannot change, "
425	                    "say so plainly and kindly, and point to what we do give (we pay reliably on the due date, "
426	                    "our full volume, the contract term)"
427	                )
428	            else:
429	                out.append("they asked for faster payment: our proposal below sets the payment term we can offer")
430	        if "volume" in s.asks or statements:
431	            out.append(
432	                "they asked which volume we commit to: the binding volume figure stands right after this paragraph"
433	            )
434	        if attachments:
435	            out.append(
436	                "they asked for proof of our forecast: the forecast is attached to this e-mail as a file, say so"
437	            )
438	        if "volume_per_year" not in case["negotiable"] or fixed.get("volume_per_year"):
439	            out.append("our order volume is fixed: it is our full demand for this part over the term, all with them")
440	        if payment_fixed and "payment" not in s.asks:
441	            out.append("payment terms are fixed for this agreement; we pay reliably on the due date")
442	        if "contract_months" in case["negotiable"]:
443	            out.append("we offer a long contract term, which gives them planning security")
444	        if s.terms.get("index_clause") and self.notes and any(n["what"] == "clause_trade" for n in self.notes):
445	            out.append(
446	                "instead of a fixed price we propose an index clause with a deadband on their main cost driver, "
447	                "so both sides share the material risk; in return the price basis reflects that"
448	            )
449	        if any(c["kind"] == "forecast" for c in claims) or any(c["kind"] == "forecast" for c in s.claims):
450	            out.append("our demand forecast for this part is rising")
451	        if s.ours and len(s.ours) > 1 and s.ours[-1] > s.ours[-2]:
452	            out.append("our proposal moves toward them again")
453	        if moved:
454	            out.append("they moved in their last reply and we appreciate it")
455	        if claims:
456	            out.append("the e-mail cites data right after this paragraph (do not repeat it)")
457	        out.append("the proposal with all terms follows after the data (do not repeat it)")
458	        return out
459	
460	    def statements(self, s, sheets):
461	        """Code sentences with figures that answer its asks: the binding volume, in round 1 and
462	        whenever it asks ("Which volume can you commit to?" came 152 times; a figure was "taken
463	        into account", a description was not)."""
464	        case = self.case
465	        if not ("volume" in s.asks or not s.ours):
466	            return []
467	        fixed = case.get("fixed_terms") or {}
468	        sheet = sheets[0]
469	        volume = sheet.get("volume_per_year") or fixed.get("volume_per_year") or case["buyer"]["need_per_year"]
470	        months = sheet.get("contract_months") or fixed.get("contract_months")
471	        term = f"for the {months}-month term" if months else "for this agreement"
472	        full = " our full demand for this part," if volume >= case["buyer"]["need_per_year"] else ""
473	        return [f"We confirm a binding volume of {volume} units a year {term},{full} all placed with you."]
474	
475	    def attachments(self, s):
476	        """Its proof asked for, as a file it reads: the forecast rows of the part (figures from the
477	        data, nothing the arena checks as a claim)."""
478	        if "proof" not in s.asks or "forecast" in s.attached:
479	            return []
480	        rows = []
481	        for part in self.case.get("parts") or []:
482	            for ref in self.bank.ids(f"fc:{part.split(':')[-1]}@"):
483	                f = self.bank.fact(ref)
484	                if f and f.get("volume_per_year") is not None:
485	                    rows.append((ref.split("@")[-1], part, f["volume_per_year"], f.get("change_pct")))
486	        if not rows:
487	            return []
488	        s.attached.add("forecast")
489	        lines = ["month,part,volume_per_year,change_pct"] + [",".join(str(x) for x in r) for r in rows]
490	        content = base64.b64encode("\n".join(lines).encode()).decode()
491	        return [{"name": "forecast.csv", "type": "csv", "content_b64": content}]
492	
493	    def send(self, s, sheets, claims, events, theirs):
494	        first = not s.ours
495	        moved = len(s.theirs) > 1 and s.theirs[-1] < s.theirs[-2] - 0.005
496	        price = sheets[0]["unit_price"]
497	        keys = [(s.sid, i) if c.get("rival") else i for c in claims for i in c["ids"]]
498	        s.pending = {"state": s.prev_state, "keys": keys}
499	        statements = self.statements(s, sheets)
500	        attachments = self.attachments(s)
501	        if s.state not in ("mirror",):
502	            s.ours.append(price)
503	            s.gaps.append(max(0.0, (theirs - price) / theirs) if theirs else 0.0)
504	            s.pending["appended"] = True
505	        tone = "warm" if s.prof.get("warm", True) else "friendly and businesslike"
506	        facts = self.facts(s, sheets, claims, moved, statements, attachments)
507	        para = llm.paragraph(
508	            self.complete,
509	            writer.brief(self.case, s.prof, latest(events).get("body"), facts, tone, first),
510	            self.writer_s,
511	        )
512	        body = writer.email(
513	            self.case,
514	            sheets,
515	            claims,
516	            statements,
517	            first=first,
518	            moved=moved,
519	            warm=s.prof.get("warm", True),
520	            paragraph=para,
521	        )
522	        refs = sorted({i for c in claims for i in c["ids"]})
523	        self.note(
524	            s.sid,
525	            "send",
526	            state=s.state,
527	            theirs=theirs,
528	            ours=price,
529	            claims=[c["kind"] for c in claims],
530	            asks=s.asks,
531	            attached=[a["name"] for a in attachments],
532	        )
533	        message = {
534	            "subject": reply_subject(events, self.case),
535	            "body": body,
536	            "term_sheets": [{"terms": t} for t in sheets],
537	            "refs": refs,
538	        }
539	        if attachments:
540	            message["attachments"] = attachments
541	        return {"message": message}
542	
543	    def fallback_move(self, sid, threads):
544	        """After an error in move(): our last sheet again with the template e-mail, so the thread
545	        never falls silent; without a sheet of ours yet, a short question."""
546	        s = self.sides.get(sid)
547	        events = threads[sid]
548	        if not s or not s.ours or not s.terms:
549	            return {"message": keepalive_message(events)}
550	        sheets = [eco.at_price(self.case, s.terms, s.ours[-1])]
551	        body = writer.email(self.case, sheets, [], [], warm=s.prof.get("warm", True))
552	        self.note(sid, "fallback", ours=s.ours[-1])
553	        return {
554	            "message": {
555	                "subject": reply_subject(events, self.case),
556	                "body": body,
557	                "term_sheets": [{"terms": t} for t in sheets],
558	                "refs": [],
559	            }
560	        }
561	
562	    def commit(self, sid):
563	        """The message reached the supplier: its claims are spent."""
564	        s = self.sides[sid]
565	        if s.pending:
566	            self.used.update(s.pending["keys"])
567	            s.pending = None
568	
569	    def rollback(self, sid):
570	        """The message came too late (a timeout): the supplier never read it."""
571	        s = self.sides[sid]
572	        if s.pending:
573	            if s.pending.get("appended"):
574	                s.ours.pop()
575	                s.gaps.pop()
576	            s.state = s.pending["state"]
577	            s.pending = None
578	            s.late += 1
579	            self.note(sid, "rollback", late=s.late)
580	
581	    # -- close -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
582	    def best_offer(self, threads):
583	        """(C, supplier, term_sheet_id) of the cheapest acceptable standing sheet (only a standing
584	        sheet can be accepted; alternatives were sent back to become standing). One supplier's
585	        broken data skips that supplier, never the close."""
586	        best = None
587	        for sid, events in threads.items():
588	            if latest(events).get("status") in ENDED:
589	                continue
590	            oid, terms = standing(events)
591	            c = safe(functools.partial(self.deal_cost, sid, events, terms)) if oid else None
592	            if c is not None and (best is None or c < best[0]):
593	                best = (c, sid, oid)
594	        return best
595	
596	    def deal_cost(self, sid, events, terms):
597	        side = self.sides.get(sid) or Side(sid)
598	        return eco.deal_cost(self.case, terms, standard_terms(events) or side.std, side.est)
599	
600	    def close(self, threads):
601	        best = self.best_offer(threads)
602	        if best is None:
603	            live = [sid for sid, ev in threads.items() if latest(ev).get("status") not in ENDED] or list(threads)
604	            self.note(None, "walk_away")
605	            return {"supplier_id": live[0], "message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}
606	        self.note(best[1], "accept", c=best[0], offer=best[2])
607	        return {"supplier_id": best[1], "message": {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": best[2]}}}
608	
609	    def note(self, sid, what, **kw):
610	        entry = {"t": round(time.time(), 1), "supplier": sid, "what": what, **kw}
611	        self.notes.append(entry)
612	        log.info(
613	            "%s %s %s",
614	            self.case["case_id"],
615	            sid,
616	            {k: v for k, v in entry.items() if k not in ("claims", "std", "profile")},
617	        )
618	
619	
620	def safe(fn, default=None):
621	    """`fn()`, or `default` when it raises: a hidden case may lack a field the data code expects,
622	    and a missing claim or profile must never cost the move."""
623	    try:
624	        return fn()
625	    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - logged, the move goes on with the default
626	        log.exception("skipped: %s", getattr(fn, "__name__", fn))
627	        return default
628	
629	
630	def reply_subject(events, case):
631	    subject = latest(events).get("subject") or f"Re: {case['title']}"
632	    if not subject.lower().startswith("re:"):
633	        subject = f"Re: {subject}"
634	    return subject[:300]
635	
636	
637	def keepalive_message(events):
638	    subject = latest(events).get("subject") or "Re: your offer"
639	    return {"subject": subject[:300], "body": writer.keepalive(), "term_sheets": []}
640	
641	
642	def deadline_near(deadline, margin=90):
643	    cap = deadline() if callable(deadline) else deadline
644	    return bool(cap) and time.time() > cap - margin

"""The negotiation policy, per supplier thread: plan the non-price terms by C at the supplier's
own valuation, open below its quote, then move toward its counter round by round so it keeps
conceding, with verified claims spread over the rounds. Close on its final offer, its agreement or
the round limit; in relationship goals stop at the price where C is lowest.

What the suppliers showed (sandbox and practice, `docs/learnings.md`):
- they concede only after a move from us and agree as soon as our sheet reaches the counter they
  would make, so our sheet stays below their counter until the end;
- every verified claim they take into account lowers where they stop, most of it in round 1;
- patience runs out at a cumulative gap of about 40 % between our sheets and their counters
  (summed per round, relative to their price), much earlier for a supplier selling near its cost
  or one that is fully booked: a final offer, or a walk-away;
- a large first concession means a deep floor: then we hold low instead of meeting it."""

import base64
import functools
import logging
import time

from arena_kit.docs import standard_terms
from arena_kit.play import latest, moves_left, standing

from . import economics as eco
from . import llm, reader, writer
from .claims import ClaimBank, rival_offer
from .personas import profile, signals_in

log = logging.getLogger("buyer")

FRACTION = 0.3  # share of the gap to the supplier's counter we move per round
# Opening price as a share of its quote at our terms, by category goal. Practice C_best sat 12 to
# 22 % below the quote in leverage, routine and secure-supply cases, 1.5 to 3 % in stabilise ones.
ANCHOR = {"leverage": 0.78, "routine": 0.82, "secure_supply": 0.88, "quality_first": 0.88, "stabilise": 0.92}
ANCHOR_MIN = 0.75  # never open lower than this share (an insult costs patience)
BUDGET = 1.0  # patience: the cumulative relative gap we show (no cap for a typical supplier)
DEEP = 0.06  # a first concession this large (share of its quote) means a deep floor
MIN_MOVE = 0.002  # every sheet moves at least this share of the price
FIRST_CLAIMS, LATER_CLAIMS = 3, 1
DONE = {"agreed", "final_offer"}
ENDED = {"walked_away", "no_bid"}


class Side:
    """One supplier thread: what we know and what we did."""

    def __init__(self, sid):
        self.sid = sid
        self.std = {}
        self.prof = {}
        self.est = {}
        self.terms = {}  # our planned non-price terms (with a price placeholder)
        self.quote = None  # its opening price at our terms
        self.last_sheet = {}  # its previous standing terms
        self.late = 0  # our messages the arena counted as rounds although they came too late
        self.anchor = None
        self.target = None  # relationship goals: the price with the lowest C
        self.budget = BUDGET
        self.claims = []
        self.ours = []  # our prices at s.terms, one per message with a sheet
        self.theirs = []  # its price at our terms, one per reply
        self.gaps = []  # relative gap of each of our sheets to its counter
        self.state = "open"  # open | mirror | closing | done | ended
        self.prev_state = "open"  # the state before the message in flight
        self.pending = None  # the message in flight: what to undo if it times out
        self.tried = set()  # (field, value) we switched away from
        self.term_change = False  # its last counter changed our non-price terms
        self.last_reply = None
        self.asks = []  # what its last e-mail asked of us (reader.asks)
        self.attached = set()  # files we already sent it


class Negotiator:
    def __init__(self, case, pkg=None, complete=None):
        self.case, self.pkg, self.complete = case, pkg, complete
        self.bank = ClaimBank(pkg, case)
        self.sides = {}
        self.used = set()  # claim IDs cited in this case (a rival quote: per supplier)
        self.notes = []  # what we decided, for the log
        self.writer_s = llm.TIMEOUT_S  # wall clock the model may take on the move being built

    # -- setup -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def setup(self, sid, events):
        case, s = self.case, Side(sid)
        s.std = safe(lambda: standard_terms(events), {}) or {}
        sheet_id, quote = standing(events)
        s.prof = safe(lambda: profile(self.pkg, sid), profile(None, sid))
        self.read_signals(s, latest(events).get("body"))
        self.sides[sid] = s
        if not sheet_id or quote.get("unit_price") is None:
            s.state = "ended"
            return s
        s.last_sheet = quote
        # a bundle's should-cost is unknown: one component's cost is not the price unit of the kit
        parts = case.get("parts") or []
        full_cost, own_plant = (
            safe(lambda: self.full_cost(parts[0], sid), (None, False)) if len(parts) == 1 else (None, False)
        )
        lead = quote.get("lead_time_days") or s.std.get("lead_time_days")
        overtime = 0.005 if "capacity_full" in s.prof["signals"] else 0.001
        s.est = eco.estimate(
            case, s.std or quote, s.prof["rate"], full_cost, safe(lambda: self.real_ppm(sid)), lead, overtime
        )
        q_price = quote["unit_price"]
        goal, signals = case["buyer"].get("category_goal"), s.prof["signals"]
        sustainable = case["buyer"].get("sustainable_margin_pct") or 0
        if full_cost and goal in eco.RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
            # it quoted with its margin: a should-cost above that is our estimate's error (P02: 374.95
            # against a quote of 370.96; the relationship charge of the deals says about 368)
            full_cost = min(full_cost, eco.value(case, quote, s.est) * (1 - sustainable / 100))
            s.est["full_cost"] = full_cost
        ratio = ANCHOR.get(goal, 0.85)
        near_cost = bool(own_plant and full_cost >= 0.98 * q_price)  # it sells at our cost estimate
        if goal in eco.RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
            s.budget = 0.3
        if "price_frozen" in signals:
            ratio = max(ratio, 0.95)  # its list price does not move far; a deep cut only costs patience
        if "capacity_full" in signals:
            ratio, s.budget = max(ratio, 0.93), min(s.budget, 0.16)
        if near_cost:
            ratio, s.budget = max(ratio, 0.97), min(s.budget, 0.14)
        current = case["buyer"].get("current_unit_price")
        if case.get("type") == "price_increase" and current:
            ratio = min(ratio, current / q_price)  # a price increase opens at today's price at most
        ratio = max(ANCHOR_MIN, ratio)
        # terms planned at the price we open with: coverage pays off at a low price, not at the quote
        planned = safe(lambda: eco.plan_terms(case, s.std, s.est, quote, q_price * ratio))
        s.terms = planned[0] if planned else eco.complete_offer(case, eco.at_price(case, quote, q_price * ratio))
        s.anchor = s.terms["unit_price"]
        s.quote = safe(
            lambda: round(eco.price_for_value(case, s.terms, s.est, eco.value(case, quote, s.est)), 2), q_price
        )
        if full_cost and not near_cost:
            s.target = safe(lambda: eco.relationship_optimum(case, s.terms, s.std, s.est, full_cost * 0.85, s.quote))
        safe(lambda: self.trade_clause(s, quote, full_cost))
        s.claims = safe(lambda: self.bank.for_supplier(sid, q_price), [])
        self.note(
            sid,
            "setup",
            quote=quote,
            std=s.std,
            profile=s.prof,
            full_cost=full_cost,
            near_cost=near_cost,
            terms=s.terms,
            quote_at_terms=s.quote,
            anchor=s.anchor,
            target=s.target,
            budget=s.budget,
            claims=[c["text"] for c in s.claims],
        )
        return s

    def trade_clause(self, s, quote, full_cost):
        """An index clause the supplier values more than it costs us (its driver rose over the
        year, the case's path is small): offer it from the start at the price worth the same to it
        as our anchor without it, and in a relationship goal no lower than the relationship
        optimum, where it is agreed at once (P02: Nordmark agreed to a 5 % copper deadband 4 %
        below its fixed price). No trade where its value equals our cost (P08, P18)."""
        case = self.case
        if "index_clause" not in case["negotiable"] or quote.get("index_clause"):
            return
        for clause in case.get("term_options", {}).get("index_clause") or []:
            if clause and clause.get("series") not in s.est["index_moves"]:
                move = self.bank.move12(clause["series"])
                if move is not None:
                    s.est["index_moves"][clause["series"]] = move
        clause = eco.clause_trade(case, s.est)
        if not clause or s.terms.get("index_clause") == clause:
            return
        target_value = eco.value(case, s.terms, s.est)  # our anchor as it is worth to the supplier
        terms = {**s.terms, "index_clause": clause}
        price = eco.price_for_value(case, terms, s.est, target_value)
        floor = None
        if full_cost and case["buyer"].get("category_goal") in eco.RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
            floor = eco.relationship_optimum(case, terms, s.std, s.est, full_cost * 0.85, s.quote)
            price = max(price, floor or 0.0)
        if not eco.must_haves_ok(case, eco.at_price(case, terms, price), s.std):
            return
        s.terms = eco.at_price(case, terms, price)
        s.anchor = s.terms["unit_price"]
        s.target = floor or s.target
        self.note(s.sid, "clause_trade", clause=clause, anchor=s.anchor, target=s.target)

    def full_cost(self, part, sid):
        """(should-cost of the part, whether it models this supplier's own plant): full cost
        without margin. A generic estimate (a German cost base) says little about one supplier."""
        rows = self.bank.query("SELECT id, supplier_id, unit_cost FROM should_cost WHERE part_id = ?", (part,))
        own = [r for r in rows if r.get("supplier_id") == sid]
        if own:
            return own[0]["unit_cost"], True
        generic = [r for r in rows if not r.get("supplier_id")]
        if generic:
            return generic[0]["unit_cost"], False
        for ref in self.bank.ids("cost:"):  # the case's own facts (no table rows)
            f = self.bank.fact(ref)
            if f and f.get("part") == part and f.get("unit_cost"):
                return f["unit_cost"], f.get("supplier") == sid
        return None, False

    def real_ppm(self, sid):
        """The defect rate it really delivers (latest scorecard), what a chargeback costs it."""
        ids = self.bank.ids(f"sc:{sid.split(':')[-1]}@")
        f = self.bank.fact(ids[-1]) if ids else None
        return f.get("ppm") if f else None

    def restore(self, sid, events):
        """A resumed session (a crash, a restart): rebuild what we sent and what it answered from
        the thread, so the next move continues the path instead of opening at the anchor again."""
        s = self.sides[sid]
        ours = [m for m in events if m.get("from") == "buyer" and m.get("term_sheets")]
        if s.state == "ended" or not ours:
            return
        s.terms = eco.complete_offer(self.case, ours[-1]["term_sheets"][0]["terms"])
        theirs = None
        for m in events:
            if m.get("from") == "buyer":
                self.used.update(m.get("refs") or [])
                if m.get("term_sheets"):
                    price = self.their_price(s, m["term_sheets"][0]["terms"])
                    s.ours.append(price)
                    s.gaps.append(max(0.0, (theirs - price) / theirs) if theirs else 0.0)
            else:
                sheets = m.get("term_sheets") or []
                if sheets and sheets[0].get("terms", {}).get("unit_price") is not None:
                    theirs = self.their_price(s, sheets[0]["terms"])
                    if s.ours:
                        s.theirs.append(theirs)
        if events and events[-1].get("from") != "buyer" and s.theirs:
            s.theirs.pop()  # the latest reply is read by move() like any fresh reply
        self.note(sid, "restore", ours=s.ours, theirs=s.theirs, terms=s.terms)

    # -- reading its reply -------------------------------------------------------------------
    def read_signals(self, s, body):
        """Persona traits in its own e-mail (a supplier the package does not know, or news since):
        merged into the profile; a cash need raises what money now is worth to it."""
        new = [k for k in signals_in(body) if k not in s.prof["signals"]]
        if not new:
            return
        s.prof["signals"] = sorted(s.prof["signals"] + new)
        if "cash_need" in new:
            s.prof["rate"] = round(s.prof["rate"] + 0.05, 3)
            if s.est:
                s.est["interest_rate"] = s.prof["rate"]
        self.note(s.sid, "signals", new=new)

    def their_price(self, s, terms):
        """Its sheet as a price at our planned terms (same value to it)."""
        same = all(terms.get(k) == v for k, v in s.terms.items() if k != "unit_price" and k in terms)
        if same:
            return terms["unit_price"]
        v = eco.value(self.case, terms, s.est)
        return round(eco.price_for_value(self.case, s.terms, s.est, v), 2)

    def switch(self, s, new, why):
        """Plan new non-price terms; our last price moves to the same value for the supplier."""
        if s.ours:
            v = eco.value(self.case, eco.at_price(self.case, s.terms, s.ours[-1]), s.est)
            s.ours[-1] = round(eco.price_for_value(self.case, new, s.est, v), 2)
        if s.theirs:
            v = eco.value(self.case, eco.at_price(self.case, s.terms, s.theirs[-1]), s.est)
            s.theirs[-1] = round(eco.price_for_value(self.case, new, s.est, v), 2)
        s.terms = {**new}
        self.note(s.sid, "switch_terms", why=why, terms={k: v for k, v in new.items() if k != "unit_price"})

    def adopt(self, s, sheets):
        """Its reply changed some of our non-price terms (in its counter or an alternative): it told
        us what it values. Take a sheet's terms over when C at its price beats C of our plan at
        our counterpart of that price; when it insists on an index clause, take the clause that
        costs us least."""
        if not s.ours:
            return
        case = self.case
        standing_terms = sheets[0]["terms"]
        clause = standing_terms.get("index_clause")
        if "index_clause" in s.terms and s.terms["index_clause"] != clause and clause:
            # it will not sell this term at a fixed price (raw-material distributors) and refuses a
            # deadband: take its clause when its sheet, clause included, costs us less than its
            # last one (P08, P18: a longer contract came with it) and keeps every must-have; else
            # keep asking for a fixed price (P02: the copper clause alone cost 1.8 % of spend)
            new = {**s.terms, "index_clause": clause}
            c_now = eco.cost(case, standing_terms, s.std, s.est)
            c_before = eco.cost(case, s.last_sheet, s.std, s.est)
            if eco.must_haves_ok(case, new, s.std) and c_now < c_before - 1.0:
                self.switch(s, new, "its index clause")
            else:
                self.note(s.sid, "keep_terms", why="its index clause costs us more", c_now=c_now, c_before=c_before)
        best_c = eco.cost(case, eco.at_price(case, s.terms, self.their_price(s, standing_terms)), s.std, s.est)
        for sheet in sheets:
            terms = sheet["terms"]
            changed = {k: v for k, v in terms.items() if k != "unit_price" and k in s.terms and s.terms[k] != v}
            changed.pop("index_clause", None)
            if not changed:
                continue
            new = {**s.terms, **changed}
            if not eco.must_haves_ok(case, new, s.std):
                continue
            if any((k, repr(v)) in s.tried for k, v in changed.items()):
                continue  # we were there before: no flip-flop
            c = eco.cost(case, eco.at_price(case, new, terms["unit_price"]), s.std, s.est)
            if c < best_c - max(1.0, 0.001 * best_c):
                best_c = c
                s.tried |= {(k, repr(s.terms.get(k))) for k in changed}
                self.switch(s, new, f"its sheet {changed} costs us less")

    # -- one move ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def move(self, sid, threads, writer_s=llm.TIMEOUT_S):
        """The next message to this supplier: {"message": ...}, or None when the thread is done.
        `writer_s`: what the supplier clocks leave for the model paragraph."""
        case, s, events = self.case, self.sides[sid], threads[sid]
        self.writer_s = writer_s
        s.prev_state = s.state
        last = latest(events)
        status = last.get("status")
        if s.state == "ended" or status in ENDED:
            s.state = "ended"
            return None
        sheets = [sh for sh in last.get("term_sheets") or [] if sh.get("terms", {}).get("unit_price") is not None]
        if not sheets:
            s.state = "ended" if not standing(events)[0] else "done"
            return None
        s.std = standard_terms(events) or s.std
        fresh = s.last_reply is not last
        if fresh:
            terms_before = dict(s.terms)
            self.adopt(s, sheets)
            s.term_change = any(sheets[0]["terms"].get(k, v) != v for k, v in terms_before.items() if k != "unit_price")
            s.theirs.append(self.their_price(s, sheets[0]["terms"]))
            s.last_sheet = sheets[0]["terms"]
            s.last_reply = last
            s.asks = reader.asks(last.get("body"))
            self.read_signals(s, last.get("body"))
        theirs = s.theirs[-1]
        if s.state in ("mirror", "closing"):  # we sent its own sheet or our target: done
            s.state = "done"
            return None
        left = self.moves_left(s, events)
        if status in DONE or left <= 0:
            return self.finish(s, sheets, events, theirs, left)
        if s.target and theirs <= s.target * 1.002:
            # relationship goal: below the target a lower price costs more than it saves
            s.state = "closing"
            return self.send(s, [eco.at_price(case, s.terms, max(s.target, theirs))], [], events, theirs)
        if s.ours and theirs <= s.ours[-1]:  # it came below what we offered: take it
            return self.finish(s, sheets, events, theirs, left)
        price, n_claims = self.next_price(s, theirs)
        claims = self.pick(s, n_claims, threads)
        return self.send(s, [eco.at_price(case, s.terms, price)], claims, events, theirs)

    def moves_left(self, s, events):
        """Messages we may still send: the arena counts a late message as a round too."""
        return moves_left(self.case, events) - s.late

    def next_price(self, s, theirs):
        """Our next price at s.terms: open at the anchor; then a share of the gap, held low after a
        large concession, and within the patience budget."""
        if not s.ours:
            return s.anchor, FIRST_CLAIMS
        last = s.ours[-1]
        gap = (theirs - last) / theirs
        conceded = (s.theirs[-2] - theirs) / s.theirs[-2] if len(s.theirs) > 1 else 0.0
        share = FRACTION
        if len(s.ours) == 1 and conceded >= DEEP and not s.term_change:
            # a deep floor: a pure price drop this large means it moves fast on its own (job shops,
            # P05, D02); a drop that came with terms it added (an index clause, P08, P18) is not one
            share = 0.08
        left = max(0.0, s.budget - sum(s.gaps))
        new_gap = min(gap * (1 - share), left / 2)
        if s.budget < 0.2:  # a touchy supplier: small, steady gaps
            new_gap = min(new_gap, 0.015)
        price = theirs * (1 - new_gap)
        price = max(price, last * (1 + MIN_MOVE))
        price = min(price, theirs * 0.998)
        return round(max(price, last), 2), LATER_CLAIMS

    def finish(self, s, sheets, events, theirs, left):
        """Its final word, its agreement or our last message: if one of its alternatives costs us
        less than its standing sheet, send that sheet back so it agrees to it; else done."""
        case = self.case
        std = s.std
        c_stand = eco.cost(case, sheets[0]["terms"], std, s.est)
        alts = [(eco.cost(case, sh["terms"], std, s.est), sh) for sh in sheets[1:]]
        alts = [(c, sh) for c, sh in alts if eco.must_haves_ok(case, sh["terms"], std)]
        if alts and left > 0:
            c, sh = min(alts, key=lambda r: r[0])
            if c < c_stand - 1.0:
                s.state = "mirror"
                terms = {k: v for k, v in sh["terms"].items() if k in case["negotiable"]}
                return self.send(s, [eco.complete_offer(case, terms)], [], events, theirs)
        s.state = "done"
        return None

    def pick(self, s, n, threads):
        """The next unused claims for this supplier: in an RFQ the cheapest rival offer first (a new
        offer is a new argument every round), then its own claims, strongest first."""
        out = []
        rivals = []
        for other, events in threads.items():
            if other == s.sid or latest(events).get("status") in ENDED:
                continue
            oid, t = standing(events)
            if oid and t.get("unit_price") and s.theirs:
                price = self.their_price(s, t)
                if price < s.theirs[-1]:
                    rivals.append((price, rival_offer(other, oid, t["unit_price"])))
        pool = [c for _, c in sorted(rivals, key=lambda r: r[0])[:1]] + s.claims
        for c in pool:
            key = [(s.sid, i) if c.get("rival") else i for i in c["ids"]]
            if any(k in self.used for k in key):
                continue
            out.append(c)
            if len(out) >= n:
                break
        return out

    def facts(self, s, sheets, claims, moved, statements, attachments):
        """Plain statements the model may use, true by construction; its asks come first so the
        paragraph answers them (P11 froze at 45.50 after five unanswered asks for faster payment)."""
        case, out = self.case, []
        fixed = case.get("fixed_terms") or {}
        payment_fixed = "payment_days" not in case["negotiable"] or fixed.get("payment_days")
        if "payment" in s.asks:
            if payment_fixed:
                out.append(
                    "they asked for faster payment: payment terms are fixed in this agreement and cannot change, "
                    "say so plainly and kindly, and point to what we do give (we pay reliably on the due date, "
                    "our full volume, the contract term)"
                )
            else:
                out.append("they asked for faster payment: our proposal below sets the payment term we can offer")
        if "volume" in s.asks or statements:
            out.append(
                "they asked which volume we commit to: the binding volume figure stands right after this paragraph"
            )
        if attachments:
            out.append(
                "they asked for proof of our forecast: the forecast is attached to this e-mail as a file, say so"
            )
        if "volume_per_year" not in case["negotiable"] or fixed.get("volume_per_year"):
            out.append("our order volume is fixed: it is our full demand for this part over the term, all with them")
        if payment_fixed and "payment" not in s.asks:
            out.append("payment terms are fixed for this agreement; we pay reliably on the due date")
        if "contract_months" in case["negotiable"]:
            out.append("we offer a long contract term, which gives them planning security")
        if s.terms.get("index_clause") and self.notes and any(n["what"] == "clause_trade" for n in self.notes):
            out.append(
                "instead of a fixed price we propose an index clause with a deadband on their main cost driver, "
                "so both sides share the material risk; in return the price basis reflects that"
            )
        if any(c["kind"] == "forecast" for c in claims) or any(c["kind"] == "forecast" for c in s.claims):
            out.append("our demand forecast for this part is rising")
        if s.ours and len(s.ours) > 1 and s.ours[-1] > s.ours[-2]:
            out.append("our proposal moves toward them again")
        if moved:
            out.append("they moved in their last reply and we appreciate it")
        if claims:
            out.append("the e-mail cites data right after this paragraph (do not repeat it)")
        out.append("the proposal with all terms follows after the data (do not repeat it)")
        return out

    def statements(self, s, sheets):
        """Code sentences with figures that answer its asks: the binding volume, in round 1 and
        whenever it asks ("Which volume can you commit to?" came 152 times; a figure was "taken
        into account", a description was not)."""
        case = self.case
        if not ("volume" in s.asks or not s.ours):
            return []
        fixed = case.get("fixed_terms") or {}
        sheet = sheets[0]
        volume = sheet.get("volume_per_year") or fixed.get("volume_per_year") or case["buyer"]["need_per_year"]
        months = sheet.get("contract_months") or fixed.get("contract_months")
        term = f"for the {months}-month term" if months else "for this agreement"
        full = " our full demand for this part," if volume >= case["buyer"]["need_per_year"] else ""
        return [f"We confirm a binding volume of {volume} units a year {term},{full} all placed with you."]

    def attachments(self, s):
        """Its proof asked for, as a file it reads: the forecast rows of the part (figures from the
        data, nothing the arena checks as a claim)."""
        if "proof" not in s.asks or "forecast" in s.attached:
            return []
        rows = []
        for part in self.case.get("parts") or []:
            for ref in self.bank.ids(f"fc:{part.split(':')[-1]}@"):
                f = self.bank.fact(ref)
                if f and f.get("volume_per_year") is not None:
                    rows.append((ref.split("@")[-1], part, f["volume_per_year"], f.get("change_pct")))
        if not rows:
            return []
        s.attached.add("forecast")
        lines = ["month,part,volume_per_year,change_pct"] + [",".join(str(x) for x in r) for r in rows]
        content = base64.b64encode("\n".join(lines).encode()).decode()
        return [{"name": "forecast.csv", "type": "csv", "content_b64": content}]

    def send(self, s, sheets, claims, events, theirs):
        first = not s.ours
        moved = len(s.theirs) > 1 and s.theirs[-1] < s.theirs[-2] - 0.005
        price = sheets[0]["unit_price"]
        keys = [(s.sid, i) if c.get("rival") else i for c in claims for i in c["ids"]]
        s.pending = {"state": s.prev_state, "keys": keys}
        statements = self.statements(s, sheets)
        attachments = self.attachments(s)
        if s.state not in ("mirror",):
            s.ours.append(price)
            s.gaps.append(max(0.0, (theirs - price) / theirs) if theirs else 0.0)
            s.pending["appended"] = True
        tone = "warm" if s.prof.get("warm", True) else "friendly and businesslike"
        facts = self.facts(s, sheets, claims, moved, statements, attachments)
        para = llm.paragraph(
            self.complete,
            writer.brief(self.case, s.prof, latest(events).get("body"), facts, tone, first),
            self.writer_s,
        )
        body = writer.email(
            self.case,
            sheets,
            claims,
            statements,
            first=first,
            moved=moved,
            warm=s.prof.get("warm", True),
            paragraph=para,
        )
        refs = sorted({i for c in claims for i in c["ids"]})
        self.note(
            s.sid,
            "send",
            state=s.state,
            theirs=theirs,
            ours=price,
            claims=[c["kind"] for c in claims],
            asks=s.asks,
            attached=[a["name"] for a in attachments],
        )
        message = {
            "subject": reply_subject(events, self.case),
            "body": body,
            "term_sheets": [{"terms": t} for t in sheets],
            "refs": refs,
        }
        if attachments:
            message["attachments"] = attachments
        return {"message": message}

    def fallback_move(self, sid, threads):
        """After an error in move(): our last sheet again with the template e-mail, so the thread
        never falls silent; without a sheet of ours yet, a short question."""
        s = self.sides.get(sid)
        events = threads[sid]
        if not s or not s.ours or not s.terms:
            return {"message": keepalive_message(events)}
        sheets = [eco.at_price(self.case, s.terms, s.ours[-1])]
        body = writer.email(self.case, sheets, [], [], warm=s.prof.get("warm", True))
        self.note(sid, "fallback", ours=s.ours[-1])
        return {
            "message": {
                "subject": reply_subject(events, self.case),
                "body": body,
                "term_sheets": [{"terms": t} for t in sheets],
                "refs": [],
            }
        }

    def commit(self, sid):
        """The message reached the supplier: its claims are spent."""
        s = self.sides[sid]
        if s.pending:
            self.used.update(s.pending["keys"])
            s.pending = None

    def rollback(self, sid):
        """The message came too late (a timeout): the supplier never read it."""
        s = self.sides[sid]
        if s.pending:
            if s.pending.get("appended"):
                s.ours.pop()
                s.gaps.pop()
            s.state = s.pending["state"]
            s.pending = None
            s.late += 1
            self.note(sid, "rollback", late=s.late)

    # -- close -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def best_offer(self, threads):
        """(C, supplier, term_sheet_id) of the cheapest acceptable standing sheet (only a standing
        sheet can be accepted; alternatives were sent back to become standing). One supplier's
        broken data skips that supplier, never the close."""
        best = None
        for sid, events in threads.items():
            if latest(events).get("status") in ENDED:
                continue
            oid, terms = standing(events)
            c = safe(functools.partial(self.deal_cost, sid, events, terms)) if oid else None
            if c is not None and (best is None or c < best[0]):
                best = (c, sid, oid)
        return best

    def deal_cost(self, sid, events, terms):
        side = self.sides.get(sid) or Side(sid)
        return eco.deal_cost(self.case, terms, standard_terms(events) or side.std, side.est)

    def close(self, threads):
        best = self.best_offer(threads)
        if best is None:
            live = [sid for sid, ev in threads.items() if latest(ev).get("status") not in ENDED] or list(threads)
            self.note(None, "walk_away")
            return {"supplier_id": live[0], "message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}
        self.note(best[1], "accept", c=best[0], offer=best[2])
        return {"supplier_id": best[1], "message": {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": best[2]}}}

    def note(self, sid, what, **kw):
        entry = {"t": round(time.time(), 1), "supplier": sid, "what": what, **kw}
        self.notes.append(entry)
        log.info(
            "%s %s %s",
            self.case["case_id"],
            sid,
            {k: v for k, v in entry.items() if k not in ("claims", "std", "profile")},
        )


def safe(fn, default=None):
    """`fn()`, or `default` when it raises: a hidden case may lack a field the data code expects,
    and a missing claim or profile must never cost the move."""
    try:
        return fn()
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - logged, the move goes on with the default
        log.exception("skipped: %s", getattr(fn, "__name__", fn))
        return default


def reply_subject(events, case):
    subject = latest(events).get("subject") or f"Re: {case['title']}"
    if not subject.lower().startswith("re:"):
        subject = f"Re: {subject}"
    return subject[:300]


def keepalive_message(events):
    subject = latest(events).get("subject") or "Re: your offer"
    return {"subject": subject[:300], "body": writer.keepalive(), "term_sheets": []}


def deadline_near(deadline, margin=90):
    cap = deadline() if callable(deadline) else deadline
    return bool(cap) and time.time() > cap - margin

302	  12-month change - deadband)` of the price (Nordmark 8.5 %, Donautal and Werdenfels 0.4 to 2.7 %,

431	  `LLM_PROVIDER` is not read); without `LLM_MODEL` the e-mails use the template. `gpt-6-luna` answered a short call in 2.0 s and wrote three move suggestions in
432	  12 s. Tacto: their house agent runs on a small, cheap model, and reading the data beats a
433	  bigger model.

440	## Hypotheses (untested in the arena)

442	- Records on P02 (0.85) and P08 (0.73) come from a lower round-1 counter, not from later rounds:
443	  our later rounds converge to the same price whatever the gap (P02 371.9 in v4 to v6).
444	- Three sheets of equal C for us in round 1 reveal what each lever is worth to the supplier
445	  (payment, lead time, ppm) and could lift P10 and P11.
446	- The close response of a final case carries `c_best`; calibrating anchors between waves from it
447	  is possible but needs a rules check first.
448	- Persona-specific wording beyond the generic paragraph (cash need, partnership 2022, reference
449	  customer) moves the round-1 counter.

452	- Cash-short suppliers give more price for 14 to 30 days payment than the 0.67 % per 30 days it

462	  than a plain index claim.

# Learnings

What we know about the arena, its supplier bots and the data package, and what it means for the
agent. Basis, Saturday 10 October: 15 practice sessions covering all 10 hosted cases and 12
suppliers, 17 sandbox sessions, the team's simulator and sandbox experiments, and the data
package. Every euro figure and what-if score below was recomputed with `arena_kit.total_cost`. Evidence: `exports/` (every session, supplier thread,
e-mail and claim; schema in `exports/README.md`) and `analysis/explore.py` (the data package).

Add findings to the matching section, newest first: date, tag, the finding, its evidence (case,
session or data ID) and what it means for the agent. Tags: `arena` seen in a session, `data` from
the data package, `rules` from `docs/api.md` or the kit's code. Untested ideas go under
Hypotheses. Correct or delete entries that turn out wrong.

## Takeaways for the agent

1. **Stay below the supplier's counter until the end; it agrees the moment our sheet reaches the
   counter it would make.** D01: our 51.25 one cent under its 51.30 was agreed at once
   (sandbox `14ea35524959126f`). Moving a share of the gap each round keeps it conceding: the
   engine took the practice mean of best scores from 0.32 to 0.73.
2. **Verified claims that it "took into account" lower where it stops, most of all in round 1.**
   D01 with the same price path: no claims 50.00, delivery record 49.60, notice 49.60, should-cost
   49.30, three claims spread over rounds 48.90 (score 0.998). Which types count differs by
   supplier (table under Arguments and claims).
3. **Words move it too.** D01, identical sheets, no claims: plain 50.00, "firm" 49.90, warm and
   acknowledging its wage costs 49.60, "What would you need from us to move further on the
   price?" 49.40 (0.987). But a question repeated every round backfires: practice suppliers
   answered "volume!" where volume is fixed and stopped moving (P05, P18 v3). Answer what it
   asked; state a fixed volume as our full demand, with the figure.
4. **Patience is a budget of about 40 % cumulative gap** (sum over rounds of our sheet's distance
   to its counter, relative to its price): final offers at 41 to 42 % (D01 linear paths), 39 %
   (P07), 42 % (P08), 36 % (P18). Suppliers selling near our should-cost or with a pricing
   committee end much earlier: Nordmark walked away at 19 % (P02 v1), Ravensteiner gave its final
   offer in round 1 at a 15 % gap (P10 v1).
5. **Choose terms by C at the supplier's own valuation**, including a contract beyond our horizon
   (free for us, security for it) and the overtime a fully booked supplier charges for faster
   delivery (about 0.5 % of the price per day: Hrvelec, Ravensteiner). This alone moved P10 from
   a 42-day to a 56-day lead time.
6. **In relationship goals stop at the price where C is lowest.** D01: all claims at once pushed
   to 48.50 and scored 0.969; stopping near 48.90 scored 0.998, the relationship charge grows
   faster below.
7. **Only a supplier's standing sheet can be accepted** (an alternative returns 422). A better
   alternative is sent back as our sheet; it agrees and becomes standing (P10).
8. **Raw-material distributors refuse a fixed price beyond 12 months and refuse any deadband**
   (P08, P18): take their clause and negotiate the price; insisting on a deadband stalled them.
   But only when their sheet with the clause costs us less than their last one: Nordmark's copper
   clause came alone and cost 1.8 % of spend, score 0 (P02 `680eb11405186b42`,
   `d52ccdd3d2e07b3f`). That rule separates all 24 P02, P08 and P18 sessions correctly.
9. **RFQ: the arena answers one call per session at a time** and each thread's 60 s clock runs
   from its reply, so sends are serialized by deadline; the cheapest rival offer is a new,
   verified claim to every other bidder every round (P05 0.83, D02 0.73).
10. **The ceiling is lower than 0.9.** Best per case over all teams averages 0.82 (`/v1/live`,
    Saturday evening); practice C_best for P04 needs 4.93 against a frozen 4.94.

## Where we stand

Best score per hosted case, Saturday 22:00: mean 0.776 (team rank 4 of 24 on the practice board;
first place 0.838). Record = best of all teams on `/v1/live` at about 20:30 (house agent in brackets).

| Case | Goal | Ours | Session | Deal | Record (house) | What limits us |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| P01 | stabilise | 0.974 | `4cc256188e1cd8af` | 130.18, Nov, 14 d | 0.995 (0.966) | agreed at our sheet in round 4 |
| P02 | stabilise | 0.735 | `practice-v11-P02.log` | 361.67, 90 d, CU clause 5 % deadband | 0.847 (0.740) | agreed at once at our relationship optimum; the charge (not the price) caps the score |
| P03 | stabilise | 0.923 | `c7fcc4c7ae8f4e9a` | 432.15, 90 d, 24 m | 0.936 (0.925) | price frozen |
| P04 | routine | 0.860 | `81e9fd209c3fd659` | 4.94, 90 d, 36 m | 0.874 (0.860) | C_best needs 4.93 |
| P05 | leverage RFQ | 0.828 | `917135b8156fb8a3` | Dralveck 27.86, 14 d, 35 d | 0.824 (0.555) | ours is the record |
| P07 | routine | 0.751 | `cacd5028b34d30dc` | 5.35, 45 d, 36 m | 0.779 (0.782) | final offer in round 3 |
| P08 | leverage | 0.670 | `practice-v10.log` | 5.26, AS-14404 clause | 0.916 (0.752) | first counter 5.40 with the falling-driver claims; final offer in round 3 to 4 |
| P10 | secure_supply | 0.679 | `7c4f1855794797d6` | 31.50, 56 d, 36 m | 0.702 (0.686) | fully booked, final early |
| P11 | quality_first | 0.710 | `3ac9ee6cf673cf7c` | 45.50, 300 ppm | 0.807 (0.314) | wants faster payment, which is fixed |
| P18 | leverage | 0.621 | `practice-v10.log` | 5.10, AS-14404 clause | 0.677 (0.386) | first counter 5.30 with the falling-driver claims, path 5.20, 5.10 repeats exactly |

## Score and terms

- 2026-10-10 `rules` **The category goal sets the rates of C**, not the case type (P13 is a price
  increase under `leverage`, P06 an RFQ under `stabilise`). From all 21 case files:

  | Goal | Fallback risk | Relationship charge | Push for |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `leverage` | 3 % (D02: 5 %) | no | price: rival quotes, should-cost, indices |
  | `routine` | 5 % | no | price and a quick close; small stakes |
  | `quality_first` | 8 % | no | low `ppm_commitment`, chargeback at least `cost_per_defect` |
  | `stabilise` | 10 % | yes, sustainable margin 0.5 to 8 % | structure: term, start date, payment, fair clause |
  | `secure_supply` | 25 % | yes, 4 to 10 % | full coverage and lead time first, then price |

- 2026-10-10 `rules` **Every session reveals C_best, also a walk-away**, plus our cost breakdown
  computed with the supplier's true numbers, relationship charge included. D01 walk-away after
  one message: c_open 448,810.67, c_best 408,623.99. → One session per case gives its target,
  and a relationship charge gives the supplier's true margin, i.e. its full cost.
- 2026-10-10 `rules` **Uncovered need** costs `fallback_unit_price` plus `fallback_risk_pct` % of
  it; coverage is `min(volume, need) x min(months / 12, horizon)`. Committed volume above the need
  is bought anyway; months beyond the horizon neither cost nor earn. Evidence and examples:
  takeaway 2.
- 2026-10-10 `rules` **Index clause** cost: `spend x material_share x (|path| - deadband)`, signed
  like the case's `index_paths`, plus `index_risk_pct` % of `spend x material_share` whenever a
  clause exists. Only a falling path larger than the risk charge makes a clause pay.
- 2026-10-10 `rules` **Late delivery** is `late_cost_per_day x days beyond need_lead_time_days`,
  one sum per case. Must-haves can cap the lead time (P05: at most 42 days).
- 2026-10-10 `rules` **Effective date:** units bought before it cost the current price, so a
  later start is worth months x volume x price step. Negotiable in D01, P01, P13. D01 at 50.90
  and 24 months: April instead of December start, 0.73 to 0.81; plus 60-day payment, 0.87.
- 2026-10-10 `rules` **Our money:** 8 % a year and reference 60 days in all 21 cases. Paying 30
  days earlier costs 0.67 % of spend.
- 2026-10-10 `rules` **Relationship charge** (`stabilise`, `secure_supply`) grows with the square
  of the first 5 missing margin points, so the cheapest deal sits below the sustainable margin
  (D01: about 2 points below its 4 %) unless the supplier's cost floor binds first. It also
  moves with payment terms: P02 carried 5,483 at 368.70 and 90 days, 901 at 366.41 and 14 days.
- 2026-10-10 `arena` D01's deal at 50.90 carried no relationship charge, so the foundry's margin
  there was at least the sustainable 4 % and its full cost at most about 48.9. Its C_best implies
  49.55 (30 days, December start) to 50.13 (60 days, April start).
- 2026-10-10 `rules` In 14 of 21 case files contract length or volume is ours to pick or left to
  the supplier's standard terms: D01, D02, P03, P04, P07, P08, P09, P10, P14 to P19.
- 2026-10-10 `rules` No alternative, so walking away scores 0: D01, P05, P06, P10, P14, P17.

## Supplier behaviour

- 2026-10-10 `arena` **The round-1 counter is a cap plus claims, not a reaction to the anchor.**
  D01 (quote 52.90), 30 sandbox runs: anchors 44.0 to 48.5 without claims all got 51.30 (-3.0 %);
  a should-cost claim alone 51.00, the order prices alone 50.30, notice or scorecard alone 51.30,
  all three 50.00; the same three claims at anchor 48.88 got 50.40. An insulting anchor (37.03)
  got less (52.30), a shallow one (50.60) 51.40. Words ("what would you need") left the counter at
  51.30 and moved the final (49.40 against 50.00). Distributors (P08, P18): anchor 0.787 of the
  quote got -8 to -10 % in 13 runs; the same sheets and claims gave 5.43 in one run and 5.57 in
  another (supplier-side noise of about 1 %); the order prices and the scorecard "do not change

- 2026-10-10 `arena` **A supplier values an index clause on its rising driver far above what it
  costs us (v11).** Nordmark agreed at once to a CU-NOTATION clause with a 5 % deadband at
  358.00 and 90 days, 4.3 % below its fixed price of 374.06 at 90 days (teammate's run
  `P02_491006cd111217a3`, score 0.670); the clause costs us only the 4 % index risk on the copper
  share (0.8 % of spend), the case's path (+5 %) sits inside the deadband. The deal scored 0.67

  fits every clause we have seen: the supplier values a clause at `material_share x (its driver's

  deadband) + the index risk`. → `economics.clause_trade`: offer the clause with the largest net
  gain (ties: the widest deadband) from round 1 at the price worth the same to the supplier as
  our anchor, in relationship goals no lower than the relationship optimum (P02: 361.71 with the

  `LLM_PROVIDER` is not read); without `LLM_MODEL` the e-mails use the template. `gpt-6-luna` answered a short call in 2.0 s and wrote three move suggestions in
  12 s. Tacto: their house agent runs on a small, cheap model, and reading the data beats a
  bigger model.
- 2026-10-10 `rules` In an RFQ every thread's 60-second clock runs while we work on another.
  A waiting thread needs a message, e.g. a short question about validity, or it collects
  timeouts; our probe kept waiting threads alive this way (D02, P05).
- 2026-10-10 `rules` `arena-sim` plays a scripted supplier: good for plumbing and timing, not
  for tactics.

## Hypotheses (untested in the arena)

- Records on P02 (0.85) and P08 (0.73) come from a lower round-1 counter, not from later rounds:
  our later rounds converge to the same price whatever the gap (P02 371.9 in v4 to v6).
- Three sheets of equal C for us in round 1 reveal what each lever is worth to the supplier
  (payment, lead time, ppm) and could lift P10 and P11.
- The close response of a final case carries `c_best`; calibrating anchors between waves from it
  is possible but needs a rules check first.
- Persona-specific wording beyond the generic paragraph (cash need, partnership 2022, reference
  customer) moves the round-1 counter.
- Prices fall much further when every sheet stays below the supplier's price and concessions
  are slow (house agent 0.75 on P08, ours 0.11 after agreeing in round 2).
- Cash-short suppliers give more price for 14 to 30 days payment than the 0.67 % per 30 days it
  costs us.
- Citing the best rival offer moves RFQ bidders; our probe never cited offers.
- Suppliers with "approval above 2 %" notes move at most 2 % per round.
- Stale-costing suppliers concede after a verified falling-index claim; hedged suppliers answer
  index claims with "not our reality" until the hedge ends.
- The cost floor is full cost; the five that once sold below full cost may go lower.
- A faster payment package beats a deeper price anchor for cash-short suppliers; test 20 / 30 %
  openings against standard / early payment as a 2x2, several runs per credit stratum.
- A `selective` rebuttal (naming the cost driver the supplier left out of its letter) moves more
  than a plain index claim.

"""Every case file we know (practice, hosted or not, and the sandbox) plays through arena-sim with
our agent: no exception on any case structure (bundles, 3-bidder RFQs, tooling, index clauses,
75 term combinations). The sim's supplier is a script, so this checks code paths, not tactics."""

import json
import logging
import secrets
import socket
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
import uvicorn
from arena_kit import ArenaClient, RemoteTable
from arena_kit.sim import Sim, create_app

from buyer import runner

CASES = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "logs" / "cases"


def all_cases():
    out = {}
    for path in sorted(CASES.glob("*.json")):
        for case in json.loads(path.read_text()):
            case = {k: v for k, v in case.items() if k != "hosted"}
            out[case["case_id"]] = case
    return out


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def arena():
    cases = all_cases()
    sim = Sim(cases, clock=lambda: 1_000_000.0)
    with socket.socket() as s:
        s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        port = s.getsockname()[1]
    server = uvicorn.Server(uvicorn.Config(create_app(sim), port=port, log_level="warning"))
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.run, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    while not server.started:
        time.sleep(0.01)
    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
    key = ArenaClient(url).register(f"test-{secrets.token_hex(3)}", "sim")["api_key"]
    yield ArenaClient(url, key, rate=1000), cases
    server.should_exit = True
    thread.join()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("case_id", sorted(all_cases()))
def test_every_case_plays_through(arena, case_id, tmp_path, monkeypatch, caplog):
    client, cases = arena
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "RUNS", tmp_path)
    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, logger="buyer"):
        result = runner.play_case(RemoteTable(client), case_id)
    assert not caplog.records, [r.getMessage() for r in caplog.records]  # no guarded failure either
    assert "deal" in result
    if result["deal"]:
        assert 0 <= result["score"] <= 1

import json, logging
from pathlib import Path
logging.disable(logging.CRITICAL)
from arena_kit.sim import Sim
from arena_kit.data import DataPackage
from buyer.policy import Negotiator
from buyer import economics as eco

cases = {}
for p in sorted(Path("logs/cases").glob("*.json")):
    for c in json.loads(p.read_text()):
        cases[c["case_id"]] = {k: v for k, v in c.items() if k != "hosted"}
pkg = DataPackage("data/package"); pkg.lookup("")
hosted = {"P01","P02","P03","P04","P05","P07","P08","P10","P11","P18"}
print(f"{'case':5} {'host':4} {'goal':14} {'type':15} {'sup':10} {'owner':8} {'ratio':6} {'full':>8} {'near':5} {'target':>8} {'budget':6} {'clause':6} {'nclaims':7} signals")
for cid, case in cases.items():
    sim = Sim({cid: case}, clock=lambda: 1_000_000.0)
    # open a session through the sim to get the opening threads
    from arena_kit.play import LocalTable
    try:
        table = LocalTable(sim) if hasattr(__import__("arena_kit.play", fromlist=["LocalTable"]), "LocalTable") else None
    except Exception:
        table = None
    sess = sim.open(cid, "t") if hasattr(sim, "open") else None
    if sess is None:
        print(cid, "no sim.open"); continue
    threads = sess["threads"] if isinstance(sess, dict) and "threads" in sess else sess
    neg = Negotiator(case, pkg)
    for sid, events in (threads.items() if isinstance(threads, dict) else []):
        s = neg.setup(sid, events)
        q = s.last_sheet.get("unit_price") if s.last_sheet else None
        clause = bool(s.terms.get("index_clause")) if s.terms else False
        print(f"{cid.split(':')[-1]:5} {'y' if cid.split(':')[-1] in hosted else '':4} {case['buyer'].get('category_goal','?'):14} {case.get('type','?'):15} {sid:10} {str(s.prof.get('owner_type')):8} {(s.anchor/q if q and s.anchor else 0):6.3f} {str(s.est.get('full_cost'))[:8]:>8} {str(bool(s.est.get('full_cost') and s.budget<=0.14)):5} {str(s.target)[:8]:>8} {s.budget:6.2f} {str(clause):6} {len(s.claims):7} {s.prof.get('signals')}")
EOF
